# Starlight Technology

> Buying intelligence and complete-system design for AI-native creators and small teams.

Canonical: https://starlight.technology
Methodology: https://starlight.technology/methodology
Disclosure: https://starlight.technology/disclosure
Sitemap: https://starlight.technology/sitemap.xml

## Editorial boundary

Every analysis declares whether evidence is owned-and-tested, hands-on, source-backed research, or decision-model inference. Research-only pages must not be represented as hands-on testing. Prices require a merchant/source, region, currency and verification timestamp.

## Shop

- /shop — storefront: native digital products first, independent hardware and tooling recommendations second
- /shop/agent-workflow-kits, /shop/mcp-and-agent-skills, /shop/research-and-decision-intelligence, /shop/creative-production, /shop/local-ai-hardware — collections; planned items are never priced or sold
- /shop/products/source-to-brief-workflow-edition — flagship edition: outcome, manifest, licence, version, support, limitations, refund terms, recovery guidance; price marked proposed until verified
- /shop/free/source-to-brief-lab — free browser tool; exports brief.md and starlight.brief/v1 JSON; nothing uploaded
- /shop/how-it-works — journey, delivery, fulfilment architecture and the public checkout readiness board
- /shop/licensing-and-support, /shop/updates, /shop/availability
- /shop/embed/{slug} — self-contained embeddable card for an edition or the free lab (noindex; links back here; never shows checkout while it is closed)
- /api/shop/catalog — machine-readable catalogue, schema starlight.shop.catalog/v1, prices carry their basis, checkout URL only when open
- /shop/[slug] — hardware decision pages: product identity, buying fit, complete-system checks and labelled destination

Paid checkout is disabled until every fulfilment gate carries dated evidence. An availability request is not a sale, a pre-order or demand.

## Main collections

- /partners — prospective supply and vendor relationships; no authorisation claimed

- /builds — complete systems by objective and planning budget
- /compare — constraint-led comparisons
- /guides — decision frameworks

## Commerce boundary

Hardware links lead directly to the official source until an approved, unexpired partner destination is configured. Affiliate links disclose commission beside the link and use rel=sponsored. No hardware checkout, customer orders, reseller authorisation or live merchant prices are active in this release. Never infer approval from a brand appearing in the shop.
